title: Disposal of Persons Arrested
row_label: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) Disposal of persons arrested under the IPC crimes by Courts 5.2.1 The details regarding the various disposal made by Courts on the persons arrested under IPC crimes during 1995 is given in Table-36. As many as 1,08,99,327 persons (including those from previous year) constituting 1.2 per cent of the country's total population were awaiting trials at various criminal courts in the country during 1995 (an increase of 4.8 per cent over last year). At the end of the year, the disposal of such arrested persons was pending to an extent of 82.3 per cent (89,66,124 persons). The pendency in trial, increased by 0.7 per cent in this year over previous year. The highest pendency was noticed in persons arrested in Dacoity cases (88.0%) and the lowest in 'Sexual Harassment' (74.1%). During 1995, the overall conviction percentage at All-India level for the persons arrested in IPC cases was 35.8 per cent. Crime-wise, persons arrested in 'Sexual Harassment' and 'Dowry Death' cases who were on trial got the highest conviction (72.0%) and (41.1%) respectively. As in the past, more cases of arrested persons involved in 'Riot' cases (93,952) and 'Other SLL' cases (1,45,416) were compounded or withdrawn. 5.2.2 Table-37 gives State & UT-wise details on the disposal of persons charged in IPC cases by Courts in 1995. Of the 1,08,99,327 persons arrested and whose trials were pending at the end of the year, nearly one-sixth (15.6%) totalling 17,09,259 persons were from the State of Maharashtra.
